meta.title: Boolean Logic Calculator - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Evaluate boolean logic expressions: AND, OR, XOR, NOT, NAND, NOR, XNOR.
booleanExpressionHint: Use TRUE/FALSE/0/1 with AND, OR, XOR, NOT, parentheses
baseConvertLive: Type in any field to convert live.
steps_boolean-calculator_1Desc: Type your logical expression using AND (∧), OR (∨), NOT (¬), XOR (⊕), and parentheses for grouping. Use 0/1 or true/false as input values.
steps_boolean-calculator_2Desc: Click Evaluate to compute the boolean result. A truth table is generated showing all possible input combinations and their outputs.
steps_boolean-calculator_3Desc: Copy the result value or the full truth table. Essential for digital logic design, programming conditionals, and formal logic study.
desc: Evaluate boolean logic expressions: AND, OR, XOR, NOT, NAND, NOR, XNOR.
